messages:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — prepping an internal quicknote for 1.7.2, targeted push tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final copy + standby/rollback owners.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary -> progressive -> all. Rollout ID: r-2026-03-22-09. ETA 09:00 PT.

Ashok: I can own rollback for core-serving. Oncall handoff: @Julian (infra), @Maria (SRE).

Maria: Draft copy is at https://rwd.co/s/1.7.2-quicknote — main bullets: perf improvements, pinned model v2.3 (internal), cost micro-optimizations. Can someone sanity-check security blurb?

Julian: Security blurb: add creds rotation note + KMS policy link. Also add a one-liner about no retained raw customer data for hosted inference.

Olivia: Good call. For external we should avoid model-version specifics — internally we can say "pinned to verified v2.3"; public note will say "minor tuning and reliability fixes."

Ashok: Rollback criterion proposal: if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m in prod, trigger rollback to v1.7.1 and notify #incidents. I have rollback scripts ready: `./scripts/rollback.sh r-2026-03-22-09`.

deploy-bot: Canary health policy: require 2/3 green checks for first 10m. Failure -> auto-stop and page oncall. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and #incidents.

Maria: Timing plan: canary 09:00-09:10 PT, progressive 09:15-09:45 PT, full by ~10:00 PT. Requesting DeployBot embargo 08:50-10:15 PT to block unrelated pushes.

Olivia: +1 to embargo. Also add "no infra pushes" note for that window. @eng-sre please hold non-urgent changes.

Julian: I'll add an Operational Impact section to the internal note with explicit rollback steps, runbook link, and post-rollback verification. Ashok, paste the CLI commands you want us to include.

Ashok: CLI for checks: `deployctl status r-2026-03-22-09` — rollback: `deployctl rollback --id r-2026-03-22-09 --target v1.7.1` && `slackcat --channel #incidents --message "rollback initiated: <reason>"`. Also recommend GPU OOM alert at 85% per-host.

Maria: Internal blurb draft (paste below) — feel free to edit: "Tomorrow 09:00 PT we will roll 1.7.2 (model host + runtime tweaks). Expect a short canary window; no customer-facing downtime anticipated. Standby roster and rollback criteria are documented. See internal doc: https://rwd.co/s/1.7.2-quicknote."

Olivia: Looks good. Replace "short canary" with "brief canary"? Also explicitly list standby roster: @Ashok, @Julian, @Maria.

deploy-bot: Embargo set by @Olivia for 08:50-10:15 PT. Canary window configured. Rollback trigger thresholds: 0.5% 5xx sustained over 3m. Auto-stop on failed health checks.

Ashok: :thumbsup: I'll be in standby and watching GPU memory + latency spikes. Will escalate immediately if thresholds hit.

Julian: I'll add tracing tags for canary traces: `release=1.7.2`, `rollout=canary` so we can filter quickly. Also upload quick dashboards for the first 20m.

Maria: Final check — I'll post the internal note at 08:55 PT in #all-hands and pin it to #eng-releases. Any objections to the 08:55 post time?

Olivia: No objections. If anything changes I'll post an update. Thanks everyone :pray:
